name: Legacy Identity
description: Who they are was decided before they were born
behavioral_signature: Lives according to family name, bloodline, or inherited reputation
under_stress: Clings to legacy when personal identity crumbles
at_rest: Carries the weight of their name with practiced grace
will_always: consider what their family or lineage demands
will_never: do anything that dishonors the name
unless: the legacy itself has become a chain they must break to survive
